title: ORME -- Monoatomic Elements
path: RS2-1: The inanimate, physics, chemistry, astronomy

posts.content:
Recently, a discussion came up concerning David Hudson's work with monoatomic elements, or as they are now known, "ORME" (Orbitally Rearranged Monoatomic Elements). I did a cursory analysis based on RS2, the birotating electron, and Nehru's research on superconductivity. This can be found on the main site under "RS2 Theory", "Metaphysics", or via the link:

http://rs2theory.org/metaphysics/ORME

The analysis turned up some curious patterns, such as a preference for face-centered-cubic crystalline structures, and a near 100% match with the "Bar Group" elements that Theosophists identified through clairvoyance.

I'll update the page as additional information becomes available. If anyone has anything to contribute to this topic, please feel free to reply here.

Orme in the "miraculous waters" / magnetic levitation
http://www.share-international.org/arch ... ealing.htm
The grotto was soon investigated by experts who found that it was highly charged with energy. Then they noticed a spring with wonderfully clear water. Analysts at the German Fresenius laboratories tested the water, finding it very pure and clean. They also found that it was 8 per cent lighter than ordinary water. Another German laboratory, Hygene Institut des Ruhrgebiets Gelsenkirchen, have also certified the water to be 8 per cent lighter than ordinary water. (The water at Tlacote, Mexico, was found to be 4.4 per cent lighter than ordinary water.) Stranger still, water at the spring spirals to the left, but five meters further on it spirals to the right.
Orme en las “aguas milagrosas”/levitación magnetica
http://www.share-es.org/nordenau.htm
La gruta fue rápidamente investigada por expertos que encontraron que estaba altamente cargada de energía. Después descubrieron un manantial con aguas enormemente puras. Técnicos de los laboratorios alemanes Fresenius analizaron el agua, encontrando que era muy pura y limpia. También constataron que pesaba un 8 por ciento menos que el agua ordinaria. Otro laboratorio alemán, Hygene Institut des Ruhrgebiets Gelsenkirchen, también certificó que el agua era un 8 por ciento más liviana que el agua común. (El agua de Tlacote, México, es un 4,4 por ciento más liviana que el agua corriente.) Más extraño aún, el agua del manantial gira en espiral a la izquierda, pero cinco metros más adelante lo hace hacia la derecha.
